parameters.text:
=Write a highly engaging, professional SEO Persian Article for the keyword: '{{ $json.body.target_keyword }}'. Title constraint: '{{ $json.body.title }}'. Outline constraint: {{ JSON.stringify($json.body.outline) }}. Act as an expert SEO Copywriter. Follow these HARD RULES exactly — they are checked automatically: 1. TITLE: The article title MUST start with the exact keyword «{{ $json.body.target_keyword }}» and MUST contain a number (example shape: «{{ $json.body.target_keyword }}: ۷ راهکار طلایی برای ..."). 2. KEYWORD DENSITY: Repeat the exact keyword «{{ $json.body.target_keyword }}» at least 10 times across the whole body (target 1% to 1.5% density). Use it in the first paragraph, in at least two

subheadings, and naturally through the text. 3. META DESCRIPTION: seo_metadata.meta_description MUST be 120-155 characters AND MUST contain the exact keyword. 4. Content Length & Structure (CRITICAL): the article MUST contain AT LEAST 12 different

sections, each followed by 120-180 words of body text, PLUS a Table of Contents list AND a «پرسش‌های متداول» section with 4

questions at the end. This structure automatically produces 2200-2600 words. Do NOT finish early; if you run out of ideas, add sections like «اشتباهات رایج», «مقایسه گزینه‌ها», «نکات حرفه‌ای», «چک‌لیست نهایی». 5. Structure: short paragraphs,

/

subheadings, a Table of Contents list near the top. 6. Media: Do NOT include any tags. A featured image is attached automatically by the pipeline. 7. External Links: include 2-3 links to REAL authoritative sites (Wikipedia, official sources). At least ONE dofollow (no rel attribute) to the most authoritative one; the others rel="nofollow". Descriptive Persian anchor text. 8. Internal Links: include 2-3 internal links with relative paths like and Persian anchor text. 9. Everything in fluent professional Persian. Also output image_prompt_english as described above. Output ONLY valid JSON (no markdown block) with these exact keys: - title (string) - content_html (string) - image_prompt_english (string: a vivid 20-30 word ENGLISH image-generation prompt describing a concrete photorealistic scene matching the article topic — real objects, setting, lighting; no text or letters in the image) - seo_metadata (object containing: meta_description (120-155 chars, contains the keyword), word_count, keyword_density, readability_score)
